courses.title: ToolTest 5 - Select Similar
courses.objective: Expand a seed selection to geometrically/topologically similar entities and check that dissimilar entities remain excluded.

steps.title: Create mixed geometry
steps.instructions: Create repeated faces/edges plus visibly different geometry.
steps.expectedResult: A model suitable for similarity testing.

checkpoint.expected: A model suitable for similarity testing.

validationChecks: At least two similar entities and one dissimilar entity exist
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Pick the seed
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Run Select Similar
steps.instructions: Expand the seed selection using Select Similar.
steps.expectedResult: Entities matching the command similarity criteria are added.

checkpoint.expected: Entities matching the command similarity criteria are added.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Use expanded set downstream
steps.instructions: Apply a harmless downstream edit to verify the selected set is consumable.
steps.expectedResult: The downstream command receives the expanded selection.

checkpoint.expected: The downstream command receives the expanded selection.

validationChecks: Selection is accepted by downstream command
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.
